purpose: Refill backlog for team1 implementation lanes. Pre-scoped so a finished lane can be refilled immediately without re-exploration and without waiting on an unrelated lane.

baseline.note: 7 baseline TS paths are already absent from the checkout because their Rust port exists (ai_usage_event, credit_gift.schema, credit_transaction.schema, tts_credit_fallback.util, app_attribution.util, and two test files).

notes: Every refill candidate is disjoint from the wave-1 lane file sets.
Refills stay inside team1-billing-ai ownership; no other team is touched.
No candidate may run Cargo, rustfmt, Node, Docker or any network command during the authoring wave.
